newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Kia March sales up 11.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Kia March sales up 11.6 pct.

text.p: South Korea's Kia Motors Corp said on Wednesday its vehicle sales rose 11.6 percent to 68,385 units in March, from 61,290 units in the same month last year.
A Kia statement said exports soared 53.6 percent to 40,007 units in March against 26,038 units a year ago.
Kia's domestic sales fell 19.5 percent to 28,378 units from 35,252 units.
"Domestic sales were hit by a slowing economy and introduction of new models from rival Daewoo Motor," said a Kia spokesman.

Daewoo Motor, an affiliate of the Daewoo Group, began marketing its new compact cars Lanos in November, 1996 and Nubira in February. This dampened sales of Kia's Avella and Sephia models, the Kia spokesman said.
"We focused more on exports in March because of a slump in domestic sales," he said.
